topic: Reviewing final version of creative settings
summary_markdown:
The design for the creative settings is nearly finalized, with only minor changes expected. [p1] provided a Figma link and requested that [p2] verify access to all three tabs: Creative, Target Audience, and Advanced setting.

Regarding implementation details:
*   **Time Settings:** The time settings feature will be disabled for now because an API is unavailable. Instead, the UI should implement a visually similar placeholder that is defaulted to disabled in the Advanced settings page.
*   **Map Facility Selector:** This selector must retain its current structure with two tabs and should not be shown on the new design.
decisions: The time settings feature will be temporarily disabled due to API limitations.
action_items: [p2] needs to check Figma access and review the three specified tabs (Creative, Target Audience, Advanced setting).
[p1] needs confirmation that the map facility selector retains its current two-tab structure.
